summary: ARC Group Securities Acquisition I, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering on August 5, 2026. The offering comprised 10,500,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $105.0 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share, one right to acquire one-quarter of a share upon a business combination, and one warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. Underwriters hold a 45-day over-allotment option for up to 1,575,000 additional units. This is a standard SPAC IPO current report, not a special-situation event.
